description: This file defines a service class 'CancelLoanFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler' that handles commands for cancelling asset owner transactions, specifically for 'CANCEL' actions on 'ASSET_OWNER_TRANSACTION' entities. It leverages dependency injection for the externalAssetOwnersWriteService to perform the cancellation logic.

classes.name: CancelLoanFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler
classes.description: A service class handling cancellation commands for external asset owner transactions

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the cancellation command by delegating to externalAssetOwnersWriteService
